node.title: AQB actual coupled family-entropy manifest payload
node.statement: Provide the actual coupled AQB manifest for sigma*=8,592,912,738: the c=2 averaged-family member parametrization, shared quotient/fiber and reusable charge data, member-to-witness transfers, and exact or interval-certified entropy ledger entries keyed to that same family with certified net gain at least 429,645,547 bits.
node.attack_surface: actual construction/import of the averaged c=2 family together with its certified entropy ledger
node.falsifier: a missing family field, a ledger not keyed to the family, or a certified net lower bound below 429,645,547 bits
node.notes: ATTACK OPEN (node 1): deficit side PROVED (B_I(256)=429645546.77<429645547, interval-certified); averaging transfer PROVED. Residue = the c=2 box-charge amortization gain (construct canonical family + closed-form ledger, net >=429645547, OR refute via independent-box decomposition). Self-contained Pro brief issued. | AQB ROUTE REFUTED (Pro, verified): convex-combination obstruction — the averaging transfer needs the family AVERAGE (convex comb of single-box counts <= max box), so box-sharing saves log|F| but the ÷|F| normalization cancels it. Gain needs a heavy-fiber theorem (forbidden, circular). See aqb_coupled_family_entropy_manifest_payload/refutation.md.
